body.name: Canonical-state global-rational quotient handle
body.construction: The handle \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{enum}}\) first runs \(\operatorname{Enum}(C)\), whose canonical lift removes all path-dependent partition choices. For each emitted state \(E\in\mathcal R(C)\), form a compact rational arithmetic circuit for \(g_E\). Two circuits are declared equivalent only when they define the same rational map on the whole cone \(\mathbb S^p_{++}\): clear their positive block-Gram determinant denominators coordinatewise and produce a deterministic exact polynomial-identity certificate, for example the fully expanded coefficient table. Emit one representative circuit per certified identity class together with the list of all member states and their shortest legal-reversal certificates. Numerical evaluations are never used as identity certificates. This handle names a terminating exact procedure; it does not assert an output-polynomial or polynomial-delay bound in the number of distinct rational maps.
